notes_for_editor: Thin record. Forest Lookouts' Norman Park page gives only the name and county. The tower list gives coordinates, 358 ft elevation and gfc-229, and nothing about construction, staffing, fires or fate. The DLG photo (about 1955) shows a fire tower at a Colquitt Forestry Unit site behind Sunset School, but its map point (31.18839, -83.76885) is not the Norman Park point in the tower list, and the record does not name the tower. Treat the link between the photo and Norman Park as unconfirmed. Wikipedia's Norman Park article and the Vanishing Georgia Norman Park archive mention no tower. Two web searches found no Norman Park tower history. The brief's status 'unknown' is kept.
